# Font explorer 2-panel redesign — Implementation Plan

> Gate-driven (codex worker via gpt-5.5 bypass, supervisor commits).
> User decisions (2026-07-10, POC-confirmed): panels reduced to a fixed
> **2-panel** layout; chart context must be **real matplotlib output**, not
> webfont mocks (measured fidelity gap: mpl applies no OpenType shaping —
> Inter/Pretendard digits are proportional in real plots).

## Target design (`docs/_static/font_explorer.html`, regenerated by its builder)

- **Family rail** (unchanged): role groups Sans / Serif / Mono, Hangul
  badges, chips rendered in their own faces. Single-select.
- **Panel A — 실제 플롯**: one card showing the selected family's
  pre-rendered REAL matplotlib chart SVG (`<img src="../_static/realplots/
  <slug>.svg">`). Caption: 실제 matplotlib 출력 · `dm.style.use
  ("scientific")` 기본 상태 (Weight/Size 컨트롤 비적용을 명시).
  Hangul-capable families use the Korean-title variant of the same chart.
- **Panel B — 타이포 스펙시멘**: ONE compact webfont sheet merging weights
  ladder + paragraph line + confusables row (`0O 1lI 3.1415 −×±`) + Korean
  line (or fallback note). Weight / Size / Italic controls apply HERE only;
  footnote "브라우저 렌더 (동일 TTF)".
- **REMOVED**: layout picker (2×2/2×3/3×3), demo picker chips, the 12 demo
  renderers, the demo grid, replace-last selection logic (single-select
  rail already). Copy affordances stay.

## Real-plot pipeline (build-time, like font-face.css)

- Promote the POC render script (`docs/_build/poc_font_panels/
  render_real_mpl.py`) into the docs build: a function invoked from
  `docs/_ext/build_hooks.py`'s `builder-inited` hook (same place as
  `copy_fonts_to_static`) writing per-family SVGs to
  `docs/_static/realplots/` (add to .gitignore — generated, like
  `_static/fonts/`). One chart per family (title, y-label, dense numeric
  ticks, 2-entry legend, `$R^2 = 0.94$` mathtext annotation); Korean title
  variant for hangul families. Deterministic data; skip-if-fresh caching
  keyed on font file mtimes + script hash (docs builds shouldn't pay 18
  renders every time).
- CI pytest has NO docs build → tests must NOT read realplot files.
  Pin instead: the fragment's `<img>` reference list == registry families
  (slug rule shared builder↔test), and the generator function is
  importable + deterministic (unit-test it writing into tmp_path for ONE
  family).

## numeric_axes gate correction (measured mpl truth)

- Registry: `numeric_axes` now = **default digit-advance uniformity**
  (hmtx advances of 0-9 identical) OR fixed-pitch — because matplotlib
  cannot apply tnum. Keep a separate informational flag
  `tnum_available` (browser contexts). Measured flips: Inter FALSE,
  Pretendard FALSE (both get a quirk note "browser tnum available");
  IBM Plex Sans TRUE, Source Sans 3 TRUE, Paperlogy TRUE.
- Update: `_measure`, invariant gate (b) logic + goldens,
  typography matrix (both flags shown), families.md / design-rationale.md
  copy that recommends numeric-axes families, explorer numeric badge if
  one exists.

## Gates

- Fragment: zero `<style>`, single script, node-parse, size ≤ 200 KB
  (demos gone), rail groups Sans/Serif/Mono, no `layout` picker markup,
  panel A img refs == 18 family slugs, panel B controls present.
- `docs/_static/realplots/` gitignored; sphinx build produces the SVGs
  (verify ≥18 files, each >5 KB, after the build).
- Full pytest / mypy / ruff / sphinx `-D plot_gallery=0` green; color
  explorer fragments byte-identical; counts unchanged (220/18/20).
- Docs claims about numeric axes match the corrected registry everywhere
  (grep sweep: no page recommends Inter/Pretendard for numeric axes).
